rationale: The tape is mildly bullish — a 14% gap holding above a rising VWAP with 2.76x relative volume and the last trade printing new session highs — but there is only ~2 minutes of regular-session structure, the 44.6 bps spread plus ~1.4% per-5-min ATR means round-trip costs and noise consume most of any scalp edge, and the catalyst is unknown on a risk-off tape (SPY -0.71%, VIXY +3.53%) where low-priced gappers disproportionately fade.
